intro.firstLaunch: Thank you for installing RefleK's. Check out the changelog and docs to get up to speed with the latest features and improvements.
intro.returning: Welcome back. Check out the changelog to see what's new in this release.

details.releaseNotes: For detailed information about what's changed, features, and improvements, please visit the changelog linked below. It's always kept up to date with the latest release notes.

sections.firstTimeSetupDescription: Pick how you want your uploads and mouse traces to start. You can change these choices later in Settings.
sections.profileSettingsDescription: Choose how you want your runs to appear on the RefleK's Index. You can change this later in Privacy settings.
sections.settingsDescription: Review your current settings. You can change these anytime in the Settings panel.

sync.enabled: Run Sync is currently enabled. You can change this later in Privacy settings.
sync.disabled: Run Sync is currently turned off in Settings. If you enable it later, this choice will be used.

index.label: RefleK's Index
index.description: Completed runs can be uploaded to the RefleK's Index, a shared dataset that feeds rankings, comparisons, and research across the global player base.

public.label: Public Profile
public.subtitle: Show my Steam name on the Index.
public.description: Best if you want your Steam name shown with the runs you upload.

bullets.steamName: Your Steam name appears on runs you upload to the Index.
bullets.switchLater: You can switch to Anonymous later in Privacy settings.

anonymous.label: Anonymous
anonymous.subtitle: Private identity, shared contribution.
anonymous.description: Best if you want to contribute data while keeping identifying information out of uploads.

bullets.scrubbed: Steam ID and persona name are scrubbed before upload.
bullets.sharedDataset: Your runs still help the shared dataset, analysis, and research.
bullets.switchLater: You can switch back to Public later in Privacy settings.

mouseTraces.label: Mouse Traces
mouseTraces.description: Mouse traces capture your movement during runs so you can replay and compare them later. Tracing is designed to have no performance impact during play.
mouseTraces.helper: This is just your starting point — you can change it later in General settings.

enable.label: Enable Mouse Traces
enable.subtitle: Capture movement during supported runs.
enable.description: Best if you want richer history and replay tools from your very first session.

bullets.replay: Lets you replay and compare runs in the History view.
bullets.turnOff: Can be turned off anytime in General settings.

later.label: Not Right Now
later.subtitle: Start without trace capture and enable it whenever you want.
later.description: A good starting point if you want to get familiar with the app first and decide about traces after a few sessions.

bullets.enableLater: Enable traces anytime later in General settings.
bullets.sameApp: The rest of the app works the same either way.

screenReplay.label: Screen Replay
screenReplay.description: Record a video replay of your runs so you can rewatch and analyze your crosshair placement, movement, and decision-making directly in the app.
screenReplay.helper: Requires FFmpeg. Can be changed later in General settings.

enable.label: Enable Replay Recording
enable.subtitle: Capture screen during runs (hardware accelerated).
enable.description: Best if you want to visually review your gameplay alongside your stats and mouse trace.

bullets.encoding: Records at 30 fps with hardware GPU encoding — zero CPU impact.
bullets.inspector: Replays appear as a new tab in the run inspector after each match.
bullets.turnOff: Can be turned off anytime in General settings.

later.label: Start Without Recording
later.subtitle: Begin with mouse tracking only and add screen replays whenever.
later.description: A low-friction starting point. You can enable replay recording later once you're comfortable with the app.

bullets.mouseTraces: Mouse traces and all other features still work.
bullets.enableLater: Enable screen capture anytime in General settings.

items.changelog: Visit the changelog for detailed release information and feature updates.
items.documentation: Check the documentation for guides, walkthroughs, and troubleshooting.
items.settings: Customize your preferences in Settings to tailor RefleK's to your needs.
items.community: Join the community and share your experience.

resources.title: Resources
resources.description: If you want the full release story, the changelog and docs are always only a click away.

docs.label: Browse the docs
docs.description: Setup guides, walkthroughs, and troubleshooting for RefleK's.

changelog.label: Read the changelog
changelog.description: See the fuller release history and version-by-version notes in the browser.
